item.title: Niigata City: Port Waterfront & Sake Culture — Guide
item.description: Niigata City, capital of the prefecture, sits where the Shinano River — Japan’s longest — meets the Sea of Japan, its harbour long serving as a vital trading gateway that also made the city one of Japan’s foremost sake-producing centres, with more breweries per capita than anywhere else in the country. The revitalised waterfront around Bandai Bridge and Bandaijima blends modern buildings, riverside walking paths, and easy access to sake tasting venues and fresh seafood markets showcasing the Sea of Japan’s catch.
